topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: The news hit me like a cold gust in an empty hallway. My flight, delayed. The words echoed in my mind, each repetition bringing me further from the calm haven I thought I was in. The important event, one I had meticulously prepared for, now loomed as an unattainable goal. The airport, bustling with people who seemed unaffected, only heightened the walls closing in around me. I clung to my phone, hoping for a miraculous update, but the screen remained stubbornly unchanged. Every announcement seemed to carry a hidden message, a reminder of my impending failure. The clock ticked, each second a heavy weight, as I pondered the unforeseen journey I now faced.
